title: 수산업협동조합의 부실예방 및 구조개선에 관한 법률 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:5:0:00005:part:1/1
title_original: 수산업협동조합의 부실예방 및 구조개선에 관한 법률 시행규칙
full_text:
Article 5 (Methods for Assessing Business Risks)
① Business risk assessments (hereinafter referred to as "business risk assessments") as defined in Article 3(2)(1) of the Act shall be conducted on the last day of each month using the following methods:
1. Identify changes in specific businesses with a high probability of failure and predict the level of business risk.
2. Predict the level of business risk in the relevant sector based on indicators such as capital adequacy, asset soundness, and profitability, and classify it into 6 levels from 1 to 6 by sector.
② The level of business risk as defined in Article 3(2)(2) of the Act shall be determined by comprehensively evaluating the results as described in Article 5(1) and classifying them into 6 levels from 1 to 6 in order of decreasing risk level.
③ Notifications and reports as defined in Article 3(2)(3) of the Act shall be made in electronic form within 7 days from the date the business risk assessment is completed. However, if the central organization has registered the results of the business risk assessment in the business risk prevention system as defined in Article 3(2) of the Act, it may not notify the association separately.
